# Northbeam Benefits Amendment (February 2025)

Effective March 1, 2025, unused PTO carryover is capped at 40 hours.
Hours in excess of 40 at year-end will be forfeited. This amendment
supersedes the PTO carryover terms in the 2023 HR policy.

Expense reimbursement requests must be submitted within 60 days of the
expense being incurred. Requests submitted after 60 days require
director-level approval and are considered on a case-by-case basis.
